markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (92%)** · Unreliable input · Defer to expert
Flagged reliability (30%) and conformal set cannot exclude InSitu (8%) on this simulated frozen section [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Benign 92%, InSitu 8%, Normal/Invasive 0% (ECE 5%) | Favors Benign; zero invasive risk |
| Conformal set | {Benign, InSitu} (alpha=0.1, 90% coverage) | Cannot exclude InSitu at 90% |
| Reliability / OOD | 30% reliability (flagged), 100th OOD percentile [F6] | Out-of-distribution input; suspect read |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Disagree (conch_musk_same_top: false) | Independent foundation models disagree |
| Similar cases | 3/5 Benign (60%), 2/5 InSitu (40%) [F5] | Split between Benign and InSitu |

## Tissue evidence
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 3, 5, 6) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical (-1.00); AI spot check 12/20 [F2] · Weak
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 0) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical (-0.71); AI spot check 19/20 [F3] · Validated
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 0) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical (+0.37); AI spot check 20/20 [F4] · Validated
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 1) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical (+0.36); failed spot check 0/20 · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; top-3 risk region deletion drops invasive score above random (+0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021–0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven (deletion +0.0008, CI -0.0088–0.0064 includes 0); `normal_lobules` (0/20), `mitoses` (0/20), `necrosis` (3/20) are Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Ductal atypia in regions 3, 5, 6 is `InSitu`, matching contrast case `BACH_0189` (80% similarity).
- Frozen-section artifacts mask lesion; lateral (96%) and inferior (81%) margins score high despite deferred call [F7].

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 3, 5, 6**: Peak duct-confined atypia (1.56, 1.28, 1.70); rule out `InSitu` and order drafted deeper levels.
2. **Regions 0, 7, 8, 9, 11**: Highest tile risk (0.001–0.004) and lateral/inferior margins (96%/81%); order recut, defer margins.
